name: Glider
about: Fretless keyboard: slide in pitch, effects on the vertical
padAria: Glider {range}: moving left lowers the pitch, right raises it; up — {fx}
noAudio: Sound isn’t available in this browser
hold: Hold the sound while the finger stays
soundHint: “Same as piano” is the sound set up in the piano (preset and knobs). Without hold, the sound fades like a real piano.
snapHint.free: Any pitch between notes — like a violin or a fretless neck. Playing in tune is up to your ear.
snapHint.magnet: The sound is pulled to the nearest note, but you can still glide smoothly between notes. Good for melodies and glissandos.
snapHint.note: Only notes of the scale sound; moving between them uses the chosen glide time.
widthHint: Width is sensitivity: fewer notes on screen means more room for each one and easier aiming.
fxd.bright: Resonant filter: a brighter, wah-like sound
fxd.vib: Pitch wobble, up to a semitone either way
fxd.trem: Volume pulse, deeper and faster at the top
fxd.vol: Quiet at the bottom, full at the top
fxd.drive: Soft saturation, like a tube amp
fxd.fuzz: Hard distortion with a dense attack
fxHint: At the bottom of the surface vertical effects are off, at the top they reach the set amount. “Gentle” builds up near the top, “Sharp” from the middle. An effect set to “Always” sounds at its amount anywhere. Echo and reverb are shared by all fingers and follow the highest one.
keysHint: Without markings the surface is one solid colour: pitch is found by ear, as on a fretless instrument.
help.what: A fretless keyboard: the sound glides between notes, like a violin.
help.1: Horizontal — pitch; vertical — effect strength (none at the bottom, full at the top).
help.2: Up to five fingers at once.
help.3: The snap button: fretless, magnet (pulls to notes) or notes only.
help.4: Settings hold effects and presets, sound, scale and range.
help.tip: Magnet helps land on notes while keeping the glide.
